description: Bound ordinary Workflow session.input receipt waiting in the current volatile Runtime Event Queue without restoring the deleted durable Outbox.

tasks.title: Add bounded receipt waiting and volatile evidence to the Runtime Event Queue
tasks.description: Extend the existing queue waiter with one budget and AbortSignal, retain retryable records, capture attempts/retries/latest reason in memory, and remove only the local waiter on timeout or cancellation.
acceptanceCriteria: A bounded waiter survives retryable transport, timeout, empty, and non-matching outcomes until its budget expires.
Expiry returns typed evidence with record id, elapsed time, budget, attempts, retries, and latest reason; cancellation remains distinct.
Matching and existing already-consumed outcomes retain their current semantics.
Timeout or cancellation preserves the current queue record and unrelated records; no persistence or second queue is added.
tasks.output: Bounded Runtime Event Queue receipt waiter and volatile evidence.

tasks.title: Project bounded receipt outcomes through OpenCode and Pi
tasks.description: Pass the effective turn budget and task signal into ordinary Workflow reporters and classify timeout/cancellation as session-reporting-failed without invoking either Runtime.
acceptanceCriteria: OpenCode uses its effective deadline and task signal for ordinary input receipt waiting.
Pi uses its effective timeout and task signal for ordinary input receipt waiting.
Both paths preserve actionable evidence and existing non-budget enqueue behavior.
tasks.output: Equivalent OpenCode/Pi action projection for bounded input receipt outcomes.

tasks.title: Lock deterministic queue and action regression coverage
tasks.description: Use fake timers and event-driven tests for expiry evidence, recovery exactly once, cancellation, late settlement, and record preservation across the current queue and both action paths.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests use Vitest fake timers and no sleeps, polling assertions, or wall-clock assertions.
Queue tests cover expiry, recovery, cancellation, late settlement, and unrelated-record preservation.
OpenCode and Pi tests cover equivalent session-reporting-failed classification and exact budget/signal wiring.
Focused Runner tests, typechecks, fast tests, and full verify are run and recorded.
tasks.output: Deterministic Issue #641 regression suite and verification evidence.
